title: RetryBench: Separating Retry Permission from Recovery Outcomes in GPT Tool Use
abstract: arXiv:2610.15884v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: False retry permission (FRP) occurs when an agent retries a timed-out tool call without support from the visible contract. RetryBench separates this error from realized recovery. Successful protected recovery does not imply reliable rejection of unsupported retries. In a 720-response key control, valid keys usually enabled safe progress, but offered changed keys elicited unsupported retries in Sol (1/80), Terra (55/80), and Luna (60/80). A later 240-response control removed the candidate and required models to supply a key. Luna still made 8/80 unsupported dispatches; Sol and Terra made none in 80 responses each. Accepting a displayed bad key therefore cannot explain all observed errors, although changed output requirements and conditions preclude a pure display-effect comparison. translated_title: RetryBench：在GPT工具使用中将重试许可与恢复结果相分离
translated_abstract: 虚假重试许可（FRP）是指智能体在可见契约不支持的情况下重试超时的工具调用。RetryBench将这一错误与实际实现的恢复分离开来。成功的受保护恢复并不意味着能够可靠地拒绝不受支持的重试。在一项720次响应的密钥对照实验中，有效密钥通常能实现安全推进，但被提供的已更改密钥在Sol（1/80）、Terra（55/80）和Luna（60/80）中引发了不受支持的重试。随后的一项240次响应对照实验移除了候选密钥并要求模型自行提供密钥，Luna仍进行了8/80次不受支持的调度；Sol和Terra在各自80次响应中均未出现此类情况。因此，接受显示的错误密钥无法解释所有观察到的错误，尽管更改的输出要求和条件使得纯粹的显示效应比较无法进行。在一项六终点研究中，移除弱契约标签增加了Sol和Terra在编码动作条件下的重试次数。另一项独立的1,536次响应的规范动作……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出RetryBench基准，将GPT工具使用中“虚假重试许可”（即在契约不支持时重试超时工具调用）这一错误与实际恢复结果分离，发现即使在受保护条件下能成功恢复，模型也无法可靠地拒绝不受支持的重试。
en_tdlr: RetryBench separates false retry permission—retrying a timed-out tool call without support from the visible contract—from realized recovery outcomes in GPT tool use, showing that successful protected recovery does not imply reliable rejection of unsupported retries.
